name: Wyckoff Portfolio Analysis
prompt:
Run the Wyckoff portfolio analysis:

```bash
cd ~/.hermes/skills/wyckoff && .venv/bin/python scripts/daily.py --section portfolio >> logs/daily.log 2>&1
```

If the command exits with a non-zero status, report the last 30 lines of logs/daily.log to Roy. Otherwise respond with [SILENT].
